country.odd: Three of these screenwriters are from {value}. Which one isn't?

rows.label: Guy Ritchie
rows.hook: made fast-talking London gangster comedies and a modern action take on a famous Baker Street detective

rows.label: Sylvester Stallone
rows.hook: wrote and starred in a film about an underdog Philadelphia boxer who goes the distance

rows.label: Ben Affleck
rows.description: American film actor, director and screenwriter (born 1972)
rows.hook: won a writing Oscar with a childhood friend for a Boston drama, and later played the Caped Crusader

rows.label: Steven Spielberg
rows.hook: directed a great white shark thriller, a dinosaur theme park adventure and a boy-meets-alien classic

rows.label: George Lucas
rows.hook: created a space saga about a farm boy, a Jedi order and a Death Star

rows.label: J. K. Rowling
rows.hook: created the boy wizard who attends Hogwarts, one of the best-selling book series ever

rows.label: Seth MacFarlane
rows.hook: created a cartoon about a family with a talking dog, and directed a film about a foul-mouthed teddy bear

rows.label: Quentin Tarantino
rows.hook: wrote and directed a jumbled-timeline crime film with hitmen chatting about burgers

rows.label: Stephen King
rows.hook: wrote horror novels about a haunted hotel and a shape-shifting clown who haunts the town of Derry

rows.label: David Lynch
rows.hook: created a surreal TV mystery that asked who killed Laura Palmer

rows.label: James Gunn
rows.hook: directed a space-heroes film featuring a talking raccoon and a walking tree

rows.label: Mel Brooks
rows.hook: made spoof comedies such as a Western with a sheriff in Rock Ridge and a black-and-white monster parody

rows.label: Ben Stiller
rows.hook: directed and starred in a comedy about a dim-witted male model who is brainwashed into an assassin plot

rows.label: Stan Lee
rows.description: American comic book writer, editor, publisher, and producer (1922–2018)
rows.hook: co-created Spider-Man and many other comic book heroes, and popped up in cameos in their films

rows.label: Francis Ford Coppola
rows.hook: directed a crime-family epic about the Corleones and a river journey into a war-torn jungle

rows.label: Werner Herzog
rows.description: German film director, producer, screenwriter, actor and opera director (born 1942)
rows.hook: made intense films about obsessed explorers in the Amazon and a documentary about a man living among grizzlies

rows.label: Dan Aykroyd
rows.hook: co-starred in a musical comedy about two brothers on a mission from God to save an orphanage

rows.label: Paul Thomas Anderson
rows.hook: directed an epic about a ruthless oilman and an ensemble film that ends with falling frogs

rows.label: Aaron Sorkin
rows.hook: wrote rapid-fire walk-and-talk dialogue for a White House TV drama and a film about founding a social network

rows.label: Paul W. S. Anderson
rows.description: British film director, screenwriter and producer
rows.hook: directed a video-game-based film series about fighting zombies and corporate mutants, starring Milla Jovovich

rows.label: Orson Welles
rows.hook: directed a newspaper tycoon drama about the mystery of Rosebud, and a radio broadcast about invading Martians

rows.label: J. J. Abrams
rows.hook: rebooted Star Trek for the big screen and directed a Star Wars sequel about the Force awakening

rows.label: John Cleese
rows.hook: co-founded a sketch comedy troupe with a dead parrot sketch, and played a hotel owner who loses his temper

rows.label: John Carpenter
rows.hook: directed a masked killer stalking babysitters on Halloween night

rows.label: Sam Raimi
rows.hook: directed a cabin-in-the-woods horror series with a chainsaw-handed hero, and the first big Spider-Man trilogy

rows.label: Zack Snyder
rows.hook: directed a stylized battle film about 300 Spartans and a Caped Crusader versus Man of Steel showdown

rows.label: Greta Gerwig
rows.hook: directed a candy-colored film about the world's most famous fashion doll

rows.label: Wes Anderson
rows.hook: makes symmetrical, pastel-colored comedies such as one set in a pink hotel in a fictional Alpine republic

rows.label: Luc Besson
rows.hook: directed a thriller about a hitman who befriends a young girl and a colorful sci-fi film with flying taxis

rows.label: Guillermo del Toro
rows.hook: directed a dark fairy tale about a girl and a faun in a labyrinth, and an Oscar-winning fish-man romance

rows.label: Marlon Wayans
rows.description: American actor, screenwriter, and film producer
rows.hook: co-starred in horror spoof comedies and a film where two FBI agents go undercover as wealthy socialites

rows.label: Judd Apatow
rows.hook: directed comedies about a middle-aged man who has never had a relationship, and about an unplanned pregnancy

rows.label: Peter Jackson
rows.description: New Zealand film director, screenwriter, producer and actor (born 1961)
rows.hook: directed the film trilogy about a hobbit carrying a ring to Mordor, plus a giant ape remake

rows.label: Simon Pegg
rows.hook: co-wrote and starred in a zombie comedy set in a London pub, and played Scotty in Star Trek

rows.label: David Ayer
rows.hook: directed a gritty cop drama about patrolling Los Angeles and a film about a team of imprisoned supervillains

rows.label: William Faulkner
rows.hook: wrote Southern novels set in fictional Yoknapatawpha County and won the Nobel Prize in Literature

rows.label: Larry McMurtry
rows.description: American novelist, essayist, bookseller and screenwriter (1936-2021)
rows.hook: wrote a Pulitzer-winning novel about retired Texas Rangers driving cattle to Montana

rows.label: Damon Lindelof
rows.hook: co-created a TV drama about plane-crash survivors on a mysterious island, and a graphic-novel superhero series

rows.label: Harold Ramis
rows.hook: directed a comedy about a weatherman stuck reliving the same day in Punxsutawney

rows.label: Nora Ephron
rows.hook: wrote romantic comedies about a widower's radio call-in and whether men and women can be just friends

rows.label: Robert Zemeckis
rows.description: American screenwriter, film producer and director (born 1952)
rows.hook: directed a time-traveling DeLorean trilogy and a film about a simple man who tells his life story on a bench

rows.label: Paul Schrader
rows.hook: wrote a gritty film about a lonely, disturbed New York cab driver

rows.label: Ryan Coogler
rows.hook: directed the superhero film set in the fictional African nation of Wakanda and a Rocky spin-off

rows.label: John Hughes
rows.hook: wrote teen films about Saturday detention and a boy skipping school, plus a kid left home alone at Christmas

rows.label: Michael Mann
rows.description: American film director, screenwriter, and producer (born 1943)
rows.hook: directed a heist film with two famous actors facing off in a diner, and created a pastel Miami cop TV series

rows.label: Robert Rodriguez
rows.hook: made a low-budget action film about a guitar player with a case full of weapons, and a family spy-kids series

rows.label: Alfonso Cuarón
rows.hook: directed a film about astronauts adrift in orbit after debris wrecks their shuttle, and a Harry Potter sequel

rows.label: Jack Kirby
rows.hook: drew the first Captain America comics and co-created the Fantastic Four and the Hulk

rows.label: Peter Morgan
rows.hook: wrote a Netflix drama about a long-reigning queen and her royal family

rows.label: John Huston
rows.description: American film director, screenwriter, and actor (1906–1987)
rows.hook: directed a detective film about the hunt for a jeweled bird statue, starring Humphrey Bogart

rows.label: Shawn Wayans
rows.description: American actor, DJ, producer, writer and comedian
rows.hook: co-starred in a hit parody series that spoofed slasher films with a masked killer

rows.label: Alex Garland
rows.description: British writer, scriptwriter and film director (born 1970)
rows.hook: wrote a zombie-virus film set in an emptied London and directed a robot Turing-test thriller

rows.label: Ingmar Bergman
rows.hook: directed a film in which a medieval knight plays chess with Death

rows.label: Lars von Trier
rows.hook: co-founded the Dogme 95 film movement, which required handheld cameras and no special effects

rows.label: Edgar Wright
rows.description: British film director, screenwriter and producer
rows.hook: directed a zombie comedy, a pub-crawl alien apocalypse and a getaway-driver musical heist

rows.label: Matthew Vaughn
rows.description: British film producer, director and screenwriter
rows.hook: directed a spy film about a street kid trained as a gentleman agent, and a teenage vigilante comic adaptation

rows.label: Adam McKay
rows.hook: directed a newsroom comedy with Ron Burgundy and a film about the housing market collapse

rows.label: Cameron Crowe
rows.hook: directed a film in which a sports agent shouts "Show me the money"

rows.label: Frank Miller
rows.hook: created a gritty graphic novel about an aging Batman and the stylized black-and-white Sin City

rows.label: Baz Luhrmann
rows.hook: directed a flashy romance in a Parisian nightclub with a red curtain and a glitzy Jazz Age tale of Gatsby

rows.label: Terrence Malick
rows.hook: made the dreamy, nature-soaked dramas Days of Heaven and The Tree of Life

rows.label: Charlie Kaufman
rows.hook: wrote the mind-bending Being John Malkovich and Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind

rows.label: Pedro Almodóvar
rows.hook: makes colorful, melodramatic films such as All About My Mother and Volver

rows.label: Nancy Meyers
rows.description: American film director, producer and screenwriter
rows.hook: writes and directs glossy romantic comedies like Something's Gotta Give and The Holiday

rows.label: Sergio Leone
rows.hook: directed the spaghetti westerns The Good, the Bad and the Ugly and Once Upon a Time in the West

rows.label: David Mamet
rows.hook: wrote the tough-talking plays Glengarry Glen Ross and Oleanna

rows.label: Frank Darabont
rows.description: American film director, screenwriter and producer
rows.hook: directed The Shawshank Redemption and The Green Mile from Stephen King stories

rows.label: Stephenie Meyer
rows.hook: wrote the vampire romance saga that began with a novel called Twilight

rows.label: David O. Russell
rows.description: American film director, screenwriter and producer
rows.hook: directed Silver Linings Playbook and The Fighter

rows.label: Mario Puzo
rows.hook: wrote the crime novel The Godfather and co-wrote its film adaptations

rows.label: Todd Phillips
rows.hook: directed The Hangover trilogy and the dark origin film Joker

rows.label: George Miller
rows.hook: created the post-apocalyptic Mad Max films and directed Happy Feet

rows.label: Rian Johnson
rows.hook: directed the whodunit Knives Out and the Star Wars film The Last Jedi

rows.label: Tony Gilroy
rows.hook: wrote the Bourne films and directed Michael Clayton

rows.label: Federico Fellini
rows.hook: directed the dreamy classics La Dolce Vita and 8 1/2

rows.label: Evan Goldberg
rows.hook: co-writes raunchy comedies like Superbad and Pineapple Express with his friend Seth Rogen

rows.label: Peter Farrelly
rows.description: American film director, producer and screenwriter
rows.hook: co-directed Dumb and Dumber with his brother and later won Best Picture for Green Book

rows.label: James Mangold
rows.hook: directed Walk the Line and the Wolverine film Logan

rows.label: Steve Oedekerk
rows.hook: wrote comedies like Bruce Almighty and The Nutty Professor

rows.label: Leigh Whannell
rows.hook: co-created the Saw horror franchise and wrote Insidious

rows.label: Raymond Chandler
rows.hook: created the hard-boiled detective Philip Marlowe

rows.label: Shane Black
rows.description: American actor, screenwriter and film director
rows.hook: wrote Lethal Weapon and directed Iron Man 3

rows.label: Dan Gilroy
rows.hook: wrote and directed the nocturnal crime thriller Nightcrawler

rows.label: Akiva Goldsman
rows.hook: won an Oscar for writing A Beautiful Mind

rows.label: Dalton Trumbo
rows.hook: was blacklisted by Hollywood but later wrote Spartacus and Exodus

rows.label: Gale Anne Hurd
rows.hook: produced The Terminator and the zombie series The Walking Dead

rows.label: James Vanderbilt
rows.hook: wrote the serial-killer thriller Zodiac and the newer Scream sequels

rows.label: Drew Goddard
rows.hook: wrote The Martian and co-created the horror film The Cabin in the Woods

rows.label: Kenneth Lonergan
rows.description: American film director, playwright, and screenwriter
rows.hook: wrote and directed the grief drama Manchester by the Sea

rows.label: Michael Haneke
rows.hook: directed the chilling films Funny Games and The White Ribbon

rows.label: Nicholas Meyer
rows.description: American screenwriter, producer, author, and director
rows.hook: directed the Star Trek film The Wrath of Khan

rows.label: Anthony Minghella
rows.description: British film director, playwright and screenwriter (1954-2008)
rows.hook: directed the Oscar-sweeping wartime romance The English Patient

rows.label: Craig Mazin
rows.hook: created the HBO miniseries Chernobyl

rows.label: Christopher McQuarrie
rows.hook: wrote The Usual Suspects and directed several Mission: Impossible sequels

rows.label: François Truffaut
rows.hook: directed the New Wave classic The 400 Blows

rows.label: David Koepp
rows.hook: wrote Jurassic Park and the first big-screen Spider-Man

rows.label: Tony Kushner
rows.hook: wrote the epic two-part play Angels in America

rows.label: William Goldman
rows.hook: wrote The Princess Bride and Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid

rows.label: John Milius
rows.hook: co-wrote Apocalypse Now and directed Conan the Barbarian

rows.label: Bill Finger

rows.hook: co-created much of Batman's look and lore without credit for decades

rows.label: Stephen Sommers
rows.hook: directed The Mummy and Van Helsing

rows.label: Zak Penn
rows.hook: wrote X2 and shared story credit on the first Avengers film

rows.label: Bob Kane
rows.description: American comic book artist, the co-creator of Batman (1915-1998)
rows.hook: is credited as a co-creator of Batman, the Dark Knight of Gotham City

rows.label: Chris McKenna
rows.hook: co-wrote the recent Spider-Man films starring Tom Holland

rows.label: David S. Goyer
rows.description: American filmmaker, novelist, and comic book writer

rows.label: Lawrence Kasdan
rows.description: American film director and film producer
rows.hook: wrote The Empire Strikes Back and Raiders of the Lost Ark

rows.label: Robert Towne
rows.description: American screenwriter, producer, director and actor (1934–2024)
rows.hook: wrote the neo-noir classic Chinatown

rows.hook: created the sci-fi series Babylon 5

rows.label: Fran Walsh
rows.hook: won Oscars for co-writing The Lord of the Rings films with Peter Jackson

rows.label: Alex Kurtzman
rows.hook: co-wrote the rebooted Star Trek films and the first Transformers

rows.label: Walter Hill
rows.description: American film director, producer and screenwriter
rows.hook: directed the cult gang thriller The Warriors and the buddy-cop hit 48 Hrs

rows.label: Andrew Niccol
rows.description: New Zealand screenwriter, producer and film director
rows.hook: wrote and directed Gattaca and wrote The Truman Show

rows.label: Kevin Williamson
rows.hook: wrote Scream and created Dawson's Creek

rows.label: Ronald D. Moore
rows.hook: developed the reimagined Battlestar Galactica and the time-travel romance Outlander

rows.label: Dan O'Bannon
rows.hook: wrote the original script for Alien

rows.label: Dean Devlin
rows.hook: co-wrote the alien-invasion blockbuster Independence Day

rows.label: Mark Millar
rows.hook: wrote the comic books behind Kick-Ass and Kingsman

rows.label: Colin Trevorrow
rows.hook: directed Jurassic World

rows.label: Philip Kaufman
rows.description: American film director, screenwriter and film producer
rows.hook: directed The Right Stuff, about the first astronauts
